FLESH BLOB SPAWN Medium, Aberration, Chaotic Evil ![](images/0.jpg) THE FLESH BLOB SPAWN IS A GROTESQUE OFFSHOOT OF A GREATER KAIJU, A WRITHING MASS OF QUASI-LIVING TISSUE. ITS SLUGGISH MOVEMENTS BELIE ITS DESTRUCTIVE POWER AS IT BUMBLES FORWARD TO BATTER AND BURN ANYTHING IN ITS PATH WITH A TOXIC SPRAY. ADVENTURERS THAT ENCOUNTER ONE SHOULD BE WARY OF ITS TENDENCY TO BURST WITH CAUSTIC ICHOR WHEN STRUCK. Armor Class : 12 Hit Points: 18 Hit Dice : 3d8+6 Speed: walk : 20
